name: Zhang Xiaolin
current_role: Co-owner (30.97%) of Henan Yintai Investment and co-controller of Henan Yinke International Chemical; director of Henan Yongxin Chemical
profile: Zhang Xiaolin (张晓琳) is the wife of Tan Ruiqing, longtime 5%+ shareholder and former vice-chairman of titanium-dioxide giant Lomon Billions (龙佰集团, 002601.SZ). The couple's wealth stems from their Lomon Billions stake, held directly and via Henan Yintai Investment, which Zhang co-owns. Exchange filings describe Henan Yinke International Chemical as jointly controlled by Tan and Zhang.
interesting_fact: Lomon Billions is one of the world's largest titanium dioxide producers; Tan Ruiqing's stake was about 8.3% in early 2026 before he sold ~1.35% of the company's shares via open-market trades in Feb-Mar 2026.
notes: Very low public profile; no interviews or personal channels found. Identity confirmed via SZSE filings naming her as Tan Ruiqing's spouse (http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2022-04-13/1212898666.PDF). Any approach would realistically go via Lomon Billions' board office / Tan Ruiqing. Alive status not explicitly confirmed, though she appears as a shareholder in a March 2026 filing.
